morphology.pattern_note: 原词无词缀。加 ber- 时保留词首 t：ber- + tikar → bertikar。部分马来西亚南部口音不实现词尾 r，仍写作 tikar。

senses.zh_definition: 铺在地上供坐卧等用途的席子或垫子，传统上以露兜树叶等材料编织，也可用橡胶或塑料等材料制作。
senses.en_definition: A mat spread on the floor for sitting, sleeping, or similar uses, traditionally woven from leaves.
senses.ms_definition: Hamparan untuk alas duduk, tidur dan kegunaan seumpamanya, lazimnya daripada anyaman daun mengkuang atau bahan lain.
senses.nuances: 核心是可铺开的席垫，不专指床上凉席。tikar getah、tikar plastik 按材料命名；礼拜垫可称 tikar sembahyang，也常称 sejadah。马来文释义据 [DBP PRPM：tikar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=tikar) 转述。

collocations.en: a mat woven from mengkuang leaves

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 社区活动汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Para sukarelawan membentangkan tikar di dewan untuk kegunaan mangsa banjir.
dual_scenarios.zh: 志愿者在礼堂铺开席子，供洪灾灾民使用。
dual_scenarios.en: Volunteers spread out mats in the hall for flood evacuees to use.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Bawa tikar sekali, kita nak duduk kat tepi pantai.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Bawa tikar juga kerana kita hendak duduk di tepi pantai.
dual_scenarios.zh: 也把席子带上，我们要坐在海边。

etymology.historical_story: Tikar carries the cultural history of woven floor coverings used for sitting and sleeping. Malaysia's Department of National Heritage describes pandan and mengkuang leaves arranged in diagonal interlacing to produce everyday objects, including mats. This craft context explains the word's strong association with woven leaves, although modern mats also use manufactured materials. These sources establish usage and craft, not the word's earliest linguistic origin. [Heritage](https://www.heritage.gov.my/en/kraf?format=html), [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=15740&keyword=tikar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 ti-kar 两拍读，联想“席垫铺开，大家坐下”：看见野餐地垫就说 tikar。声音联想只作记忆，不作词源解释。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在别人家铺席而坐时，遵从主人关于脱鞋和座位的安排。避免穿鞋踩上供人坐卧的席子；需要移动席上物品时先征询主人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于居家、野餐、传统手工艺及临时安置场景。用作礼拜的席垫应保持清洁；不要默认所有 tikar 都是礼拜垫。
